newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foreign ownership of banks must stay low - Costello.
newsitem.headline: Foreign ownership of banks must stay low - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government would not allow foreign ownership of Australian banks to go as high as the current 60 percent foreign ownership of the print media.
"It can move off zero, but we won't allow it to go to sustantial foreign ownership," Costello told a news conference.
"We certainly would not allow it go as high as foreign ownership in the print media," Costello said. Earlier he said foreign ownership of the print media was currently around 60 percent.
Costello said any foreign acquisition or takeover proposal would be assessed on a case-by-case basis in the same way other foreign takeovers are asssessed.
He said, however, that any large scale transfer of bank ownership into foreign hands would be contrary to the national interest.
